title: Vault Dweller's Last Warning
description: A lone figure in a yellow hazmat suit and helmet ascends concrete stairs toward an open circular vault door, flashlight beam cutting through the dusty air. The decaying bunker walls are covered in peeling posters depicting a grim reaper, a nuclear explosion, and hazard tape, with a director's chair and scattered debris in the foreground.
prompt: A solitary figure in a yellow radiation suit with helmet and glowing green device climbs concrete stairs toward a massive open vault door leading to daylight. The dilapidated underground bunker has peeling purple paint, hazard tape, a director's chair, and large dramatic posters on the walls showing a grim reaper with a snake and a nuclear mushroom cloud explosion. Cinematic lighting with a strong flashlight beam, dusty atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
